verdict.rationale: BigQuery's loading docs describe real-time event ingestion through a Pub/Sub BigQuery subscription, which loads data as it is generated without user-run pipeline infrastructure. They also mention near-real-time replication from databases. File ingestion, however, is only shown as scheduled or batch load jobs through the Data Transfer Service, not continuous on-arrival loading. The event path also relies on the companion Pub/Sub service rather than BigQuery itself. missing for 10: documented continuous file-arrival ingestion (not just scheduled transfers), detail on the managed event path's operational behavior (latency, schema handling), independent or hands-on corroboration that ingestion works without self-managed infrastructure.
